flow.label: DB Intelligent Analysis
flow.name: taskflow_db_analysis_template
flow.description: Lock semantic definitions and plan → parallel trend analysis and data quality agents → combined review → HTML report.

config.goal: Call semantic_get_metadata for scoped table/column snapshots and last_sync_at, then semantic_search_business and semantic_search_metrics for published business definitions and metric candidates. Resolve an unambiguous metric with semantic_get_metric and pin its published version and citation. Output a structured semantic card with conn_id, tables/columns, join hints, metric_id, version, citation, definition, units, time range, timezone, grain and filters. List unresolved ambiguities instead of choosing a definition. Explicitly mark missing published definitions as ungoverned; field-name guesses are not authoritative. Use sql_query only for necessary bounded probes, not row counts of every table. All later nodes must reuse this card.

Create a plan from the semantic card and user question, preserving conn_id, metric_id, version, citation, units, time range, timezone, grain and filters. If essential clarification remains, output blocked=true and questions; do not compute. Otherwise output blocked=false, at most 3 trend/comparison/contribution questions and baselines, plus independent quality checks for nulls, duplicates, join cardinality and time coverage. Both branches read the same plan and do not depend on each other's conclusions. Do not reinterpret pinned definitions. Bounded sql_query feasibility probes are allowed.

As parallel branch A, independently execute the trend/comparison/contribution plan. If blocked=true, return clarification questions without queries or calculations. Reuse the same database, published metric version, units and filters; semantic_get_metric must specify the pinned version, never latest. Query with sql_query and verify calculations with code. Output structured conclusions with citation, SQL, key results, units and explanation. Do not wait for or invent quality branch findings or expand the scope.

As parallel branch B, independently check quality of the planned data. If blocked=true, return clarification questions without queries or calculations. Preserve conn_id, metric_id, version, citation and time filters. Check key-column nulls, duplicate primary keys, join amplification, time coverage and outliers with bounded sql_query and code when needed. Output check SQL, results, affected scope and confidence limitations with citations. Do not depend on the trend branch's SQL or conclusions, and do not label sample ratios as population ratios.

Read the complete results of both trend and quality branches. If the plan has blocked=true, consolidate clarification questions without queries or analysis numbers. Check database, metric versions, citations, units and scope consistency. Independently verify key numbers, filters and join cardinality; recompute with sql_query when necessary, and specify the pinned version in semantic_get_metric. Preserve authoritative definition equivalence rather than rewriting for its own sake. Output confirmed/corrected/unverified results, final trusted numbers, SQL and citations, plus quality limitations.

If the upstream plan has blocked=true, return clarification questions only, without an analysis report. Otherwise compose a business-facing report from both branches and the combined review: at most 3 conclusions, verified numbers with units, trends and contributions, data quality limitations, recommendations and database/metric-version citations. Use reviewed numbers only; unverified numbers are not facts. Render one self-contained HTML document with html_interpreter, then summarize in at most 3 sentences. Never paste raw tool JSON as the answer.
